states.wired-source-tested: Implementation is wired in source and protected by source/static tests; native runtime acceptance is a separate evidence dimension.
states.source-ready-host-gated: Source implementation/harness is present but completion necessarily depends on external Linux/runtime/operator evidence.
states.schema-reserved: Persistence/schema foundation exists intentionally without a CURRENT public API/UI capability.
states.debt-bounded: Behavior is current, but maintainability debt remains explicitly bounded and may not grow until a natively-qualified extraction is safe.
states.deferred-by-design: The capability is intentionally not enabled in CURRENT.
